name: an_hockey_stick
statement: (n k : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose (i + k) k = Nat.choose (n + k + 1) (k + 1)
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose (i + k) k = Nat.choose (n + k + 1) (k + 1)
type: ∀ (n k : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i + k).choose k = (n + k + 1).choose (k + 1)
